shared_elements: human figures in low relief, shown in profile
central vertical plant or tree-like element with figures to either side
dense field of small filler motifs and ornament
band of script-like signs (glyph blocks / inscription band) set off from the figural field
justification: Both are framed rectangular relief panels whose figural field is organised around a central vertical tree-like element with costumed profile human figures attending it to either side, and both incorporate a zone of script-like signs separate from the figures. Beyond this generic scheme the depicted content diverges completely: A's figures are squat, mask-faced and embedded in curvilinear scroll-and-volute ornament with a stepped-triangle base band, while B's are tall, muscular, naturalistically proportioned attendants with large multi-layered wings and fringed garments, motifs absent from A.
